licence: CC0 1.0 (OpenAlex data: titles, abstracts as inverted indexes, topics, ids). Only works whose publisher version (primary_location) carries a CC BY, CC BY-SA or public-domain licence in OpenAlex are used, so the abstract texts are openly licensed as well (CC BY / CC BY-SA require attribution: every row's source_id is the OpenAlex work id, which resolves to the DOI and the licence)
notes: OpenAlex works API, keyless (no api_key, no mailto; nothing identifying the owner is sent). Per OpenAlex field 11..36: a seeded random sample (sample=400, seed=92) read with basic paging (per_page=100, pages 1..4); cursor paging past page 1 needs an API key, so it is not used. Server-side filters: type:article, language:en, has_abstract:true, is_retracted:false, indexed_in:!arxiv, locations.source.id:!S4306400194, primary_location.source.type:journal, primary_location.license:cc-by|cc-by-sa|public-domain, from_publication_date:2010-01-01, to_publication_date:2026-07-31. Fields selected: id, doi, title, display_name, publication_year, publication_date, language, type, ids, indexed_in, primary_topic, topics, primary_location, best_oa_location, locations, locations_count, open_access, is_retracted, abstract_inverted_index. fields.json is the OpenAlex field list (the label set). Gold = primary_topic.field of each work: a structured OpenAlex field, assigned by OpenAlex's own topic classifier (https://help.openalex.org/data/topics/#assigning-topics-to-works), not by this build. Every response is stored unmodified; the builder re-applies the exclusions (any location or id on arXiv, licence, language, abstract quality) on the stored records.
